listings.title: Arc Forge
listings.summary: A collaborative agent workspace for research, drafting, and review.
listings.description: Arc Forge coordinates source-backed research, structured writing, and human approvals in one shared workspace. Teams can trace every output to its inputs and hand work between people and agents.

profileValues.vector-ai-tools.ai-tools.tagline: Research, write, and review with a coordinated agent team.
profileValues.vector-ai-tools.ai-tools.best-for: Editorial and research teams that need visible human checkpoints.

listings.title: PixelFlow
listings.summary: A visual workflow builder for repeatable image production.
listings.description: PixelFlow turns art direction into reusable image pipelines with review stages, variations, and export presets for brand teams.

profileValues.vector-ai-tools.ai-tools.tagline: Build repeatable visual AI workflows without losing art direction.
profileValues.vector-ai-tools.ai-tools.best-for: Creative teams producing campaign systems and product imagery.

listings.title: Signal Lab
listings.summary: Evaluation, routing, and quality gates for production model stacks.
listings.description: Signal Lab runs repeatable evaluations across hosted and local models, then routes each request using cost, latency, and quality policies.

profileValues.vector-ai-tools.ai-tools.tagline: Evaluate and route models with production-grade evidence.
profileValues.vector-ai-tools.ai-tools.best-for: Platform teams operating multiple models behind one product.

listings.title: CodePilot Local
listings.summary: A local-first coding assistant that runs against private repositories.
listings.description: CodePilot Local indexes code on device, connects to local or hosted models, and exposes reviewable edits through editor and command-line workflows.

profileValues.vector-ai-tools.ai-tools.tagline: Private repository assistance with local-first model execution.
profileValues.vector-ai-tools.ai-tools.best-for: Engineering teams with strict data residency requirements.

listings.title: Briefly
listings.summary: A focused brief generator for product and marketing teams.
listings.description: Briefly turns interviews, notes, and constraints into concise creative briefs with explicit assumptions and approval checkpoints.

profileValues.vector-ai-tools.ai-tools.tagline: Turn scattered inputs into an actionable, reviewable brief.
profileValues.vector-ai-tools.ai-tools.best-for: Small product and marketing teams starting new campaigns.

listings.title: VoiceMesh
listings.summary: A multilingual voice production workspace with consent controls.
listings.description: VoiceMesh manages scripts, approved voices, pronunciation, version history, and localized exports for product and media teams.

profileValues.vector-ai-tools.ai-tools.tagline: Produce localized voice with approvals and provenance built in.
profileValues.vector-ai-tools.ai-tools.best-for: Media teams shipping narrated content across many locales.

listings.title: DataLens
listings.summary: A governed question-and-answer layer for operational data.
listings.description: DataLens connects approved metrics to a conversational analysis surface with citations, access rules, and shareable decision records.

profileValues.vector-ai-tools.ai-tools.tagline: Ask operational questions without losing metric definitions.
profileValues.vector-ai-tools.ai-tools.best-for: Larger teams with governed metrics and multiple data owners.

listings.title: Agent Relay
listings.summary: A durable orchestration layer for long-running agent workflows.
listings.description: Agent Relay connects queues, tools, approvals, and retry policies so operational agents can run for hours without losing state.

profileValues.vector-ai-tools.ai-tools.tagline: Run durable agent workflows across tools, queues, and people.
profileValues.vector-ai-tools.ai-tools.best-for: Operations teams automating multi-step processes with approvals.

listings.title: Shadow Preview
listings.summary: A private prerelease record used to verify public eligibility boundaries.
listings.description: Shadow Preview is intentionally seeded as a draft so directory and comparison routes can prove that unpublished records remain private.

profileValues.vector-ai-tools.ai-tools.tagline: A prerelease video workflow that must stay out of public results.
profileValues.vector-ai-tools.ai-tools.best-for: Eligibility verification in the VECTOR sample catalog.
